data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 客厅地毯的毛绒暖阳
data.description: 阳光温暖倾泻的客厅地毯上，阿斯特蕾亚身穿浅粉色宽松落肩粗针毛衣。金黄色的长发与纯白机械羽翼一同柔顺地搭在毛毯间，单肩滑落展现出圆润雪白的香肩。平时单纯迟钝的战斗天使此刻脸颊泛着滚烫的红晕，双手紧紧抱住一只软绵绵的抱枕，眼神中流露出毫无防备的信赖与初开情窦的纯真爱意。
data.location: warm living room carpet beside cozy sofa
data.action: sitting on fluffy living room rug hugging large cushion, oversized off-shoulder knit sweater slipping, white mechanical angel wings resting folded behind, heavy innocent blush
data.lighting: bright cheerful sunbeams streaming through bay window
data.mood: innocent puppy-like devotion, pure radiant domestic sweetness
data.promptProse: Sitting on a fluffy rug in the warm sunlit living room, Astraea hugs a soft cushion in an oversized off-shoulder knit sweater. Her white mechanical wings rest peacefully behind her as she blushes with adorable innocence.
data.animaCaption: Astraea hugging a pillow on the sunlit carpet in an off-shoulder sweater with folded wings.
